_doc: Recorded intent for scheduled tasks that are disabled ON PURPOSE. Read by maintenance/pause-resume-guard.py's stranded-task check: a disabled recurring task is stranded unless it is retire-pending, held by a pending resume, or covered here by a hold whose reviewBy has not passed. An expired hold re-alarms, so a deferral comes back for a decision instead of rotting. id '*' holds a whole fleet. Add an entry when you DISABLE a task deliberately; remove it when you re-enable or retire the task. Seeded 2026-11-05 from Gabriel's 2026-10-30 rulings (memory/event_log.md, 2026-10-30 'Stalled-resume triage') and his 2026-11-05 answer for the 22 deferred tasks (keep off, review 2026-12-01).
